params.name: type
params.description: The event type is [identifier of the event as defined here](https://docs.onflow.org/core-contracts/flow-token/#events).

params.name: start_height
params.description: The start height of the block range for events. Must be used together with `end_height`. This parameter is incompatible with `block_ids`.

params.name: end_height
params.description: The end height of the block range for events. Must be used together with `start_height`. This parameter is incompatible with `block_ids`.

params.name: block_ids
params.description: List of block IDs. Either provide this parameter or both height parameters. This parameter is incompatible with heights parameters.

params.name: select
params.description: A comma-separated list indicating which properties of the content to return.

params.name: agreeing_executors_count
params.description: A minimum number of execution receipts for the execution result.

params.name: required_executor_ids
params.description: A set of execution node IDs, one of which must have produced the execution result.

params.name: include_executor_metadata
params.description: Specifies whether or not to include the executor metadata in the response.

items.docs: Query on-chain events by their name in the specified blocks heights or block IDs.
